title_en: Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Issues concerning the Acceptance of Cases for Recognition of Divorce Judgments Rendered by Foreign Courts by People's Courts

articles.content_en: 1. Where a Chinese citizen applies to a People's Court for recognition of a divorce judgment rendered by a foreign court, the People's Court shall not refuse to accept the case on the ground that the marital relationship was not concluded within China; where a Chinese citizen applies for recognition of a divorce judgment rendered by a foreign court in his or her absence, he or she shall at the same time submit to the People's Court the relevant certifying documents proving that the foreign court that rendered the judgment has lawfully summoned him or her to appear in court.

2. Where a foreign citizen applies to a People's Court for recognition of a divorce judgment rendered by a foreign court, if the former spouse in the divorce is a Chinese citizen, the People's Court shall accept the case; if the former spouse in the divorce is a foreign citizen, the People's Court shall not accept the case, but may inform the applicant to apply directly to the marriage registration authority for marriage registration.

3. Where a party applies to a People's Court for recognition of the validity of a divorce mediation document of a foreign court, the People's Court shall accept the case and, in accordance with the Provisions on Procedures for Chinese Citizens Applying for Recognition of Divorce Judgments Rendered by Foreign Courts, shall examine the matter and render a ruling on whether to recognize or not to recognize the document.
As of the date of publication of these Provisions, the Opinions on Several Issues Concerning the Acceptance by People's Courts of Cases Involving Applications for Recognition of Foreign Court Divorce Judgments, issued by our Court under Notice Fa [1998] No. 86, shall be abolished simultaneously.
